Confidence.description: How sure codix is that a reference is to the symbol.

oneOf.description: Bound to the symbol by scope.

after.description: Return the results after this place, as a page's `next` gives it.

confidence.description: Keep the references of this certainty only; the definitions stay.

count.description: Return how many results there are, not the results.

files.description: Return one row per file, with its number of results, paged by file.

here.description: Limit results to the current directory's subtree.

kind.description: Consider symbols of this kind only; repeatable.

path.description: Limit results to this subtree; repeatable.

symbol.description: Symbol ID, its path part, `file:line:col`, or a name.
